test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_random (x Nullable(UInt64) STATISTICS(basic), p1 UInt64, p2 UInt64, p3 UInt64, p4 UInt64, p5 UInt64, p6 UInt64, p7 UInt64, p8 UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE t_clustered (x Nullable(UInt64) STATISTICS(basic), p1 UInt64, p2 UInt64, p3 UInt64, p4 UInt64, p5 UInt64, p6 UInt64, p7 UInt64, p8 UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()

CREATE TABLE t_sorted (x Nullable(UInt64) STATISTICS(basic), p1 UInt64, p2 UInt64, p3 UInt64, p4 UInt64, p5 UInt64, p6 UInt64, p7 UInt64, p8 UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY x SETTINGS allow_nullable_key = 1

CREATE TABLE t_hint_sorted (x Nullable(UInt64) STATISTICS(basic), p1 UInt64, p2 UInt64, p3 UInt64, p4 UInt64, p5 UInt64, p6 UInt64, p7 UInt64, p8 UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY x SETTINGS allow_nullable_key = 1

CREATE TABLE t_hint_minmax (x Nullable(UInt64) STATISTICS(basic), p1 UInt64, p2 UInt64, p3 UInt64, p4 UInt64, p5 UInt64, p6 UInt64, p7 UInt64, p8 UInt64, INDEX idx_x x TYPE minmax GRANULARITY 1) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE t_keys (k UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_random SELECT if(cityHash64(number, 1) % 100 < 90, NULL, number + 1), number + 1, number + 2, number + 3, number + 4, number + 5, number + 6, number + 7, number + 8 FROM numbers(20000000)

INSERT INTO t_clustered SELECT if(((intDiv(number, 1000000) * 7) % 20) * 5 < 90, NULL, number + 1), number + 1, number + 2, number + 3, number + 4, number + 5, number + 6, number + 7, number + 8 FROM numbers(20000000)
INSERT INTO t_sorted SELECT * FROM t_random

INSERT INTO t_hint_sorted SELECT if(cityHash64(number, 1) % 100 < 30, NULL, number + 1), number + 1, number + 2, number + 3, number + 4, number + 5, number + 6, number + 7, number + 8 FROM numbers(20000000)

INSERT INTO t_hint_minmax SELECT if(((intDiv(number, 1000000) * 7) % 20) * 5 < 30, NULL, number + 1), number + 1, number + 2, number + 3, number + 4, number + 5, number + 6, number + 7, number + 8 FROM numbers(20000000)
INSERT INTO t_keys SELECT number + 1 FROM numbers(20000000)
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(n.x), sum(n.p1), sum(n.p2), sum(n.p3), sum(n.p4), sum(n.p5), sum(n.p6), sum(n.p7), sum(n.p8) FROM t_keys AS t INNER JOIN {table} AS n ON t.k = n.x
SELECT count(), sum(n.x), sum(n.p1), sum(n.p2), sum(n.p3), sum(n.p4), sum(n.p5), sum(n.p6), sum(n.p7), sum(n.p8) FROM {table} AS n INNER JOIN t_keys AS t ON n.x = t.k
